backstab_endpoints.race_only_stealth: When the native race-stealth bit is present without the class-stealth bit, each endpoint is first floor(endpoint*75/100).

order: Bash x3 / Smash x5 post-DR multiplier
non-positive clamp to glance or positive hit/critical

attack_type_modifiers.Bash: -15 accuracy, +10% pre-DR, critical disabled, x3 after DR
attack_type_modifiers.Smash: -25 accuracy, +20% pre-DR, critical disabled, x5 after DR

scope_note: This closes Backstab endpoint damage and general physical damage/DR/Dodge ordering. Raw player Dodge construction, complete class/base accuracy construction, and non-default Speed source/integration remain separately STRONG.
megamud_compatibility: MegaMUD contains ordinary Backstab/critical/dodge recognition strings and consumes the stock server combat stream; no private combat formula channel is required.
borin_compatibility: Borin consumes authoritative server combat outcomes. It must not reproduce or override Classic physical combat formulas client-side.
